description: Central filesystem hub: one symlink per registered location. Symlinks only; the tool never moves originals. Applications reached through a link can modify the originals.

directories.docs: Human-facing documents and AI-authored notes you read and write.
directories.ai: Full AI workspaces: the whole ~/ai and ~/claude trees (documents, prompts, hooks and anything else kept there).
directories.config: Configuration: files you edit by hand. Not application data and not cache.
directories.config/shell: Zsh startup files and their drop-in directories. Drop-ins such as zshenv.d and zshrc.d may contain secrets; shell history, completion dumps and backup copies are not linked.
directories.tools: Tool installs, per-user data, caches and source. Each child says whether it is data, cache or code.
directories.harnesses: PRIVATE agent harness roots. Each can hold credentials, tokens and full conversation transcripts. Never commit, publish, sync or back up through these links.
directories.sessions: Agent session transcripts and history, one link per real location. Private: transcripts can contain secrets.
directories.skills: Agent skill collections, one link per real location. Several harnesses share one directory; see each description.
directories.hooks: Agent hook scripts and hook configuration.

links.name: downloads
links.description: Downloaded files. Treat contents as untrusted.

links.name: desktop
links.description: The macOS Desktop folder (registered once, here only).

links.name: recordings
links.description: Screen and video recordings (macOS Movies folder).

links.name: docs/ai
links.description: AI documents: HTML and Markdown docs in ~/ai/docs.

links.name: docs/claude
links.description: Claude-authored HTML and Markdown docs in ~/claude/docs.

links.name: config/apps
links.description: XDG application configuration (~/.config). Configuration, but some apps keep tokens or state here.

links.name: config/shell/zshenv
links.description: Zsh environment file, read by every zsh.

links.name: config/shell/zshrc.d
links.description: Drop-in directory for interactive zsh configuration; may include secrets.

links.name: config/shell/zshenv.d
links.description: Drop-in directory for zsh environment variables; may include secrets.

links.name: tools/local
links.description: User-local persistent app data (bin, share, state). Not cache: deleting parts loses data.

links.name: tools/cache
links.description: Disposable-ish caches (models, tool caches). Rebuildable but often slow or costly to rebuild; review before deleting, never blanket-delete.

links.name: tools/pandoc
links.description: Pandoc user data (itself a symlink into proj/home).

links.name: harnesses/claude
links.description: Claude Code root: settings, history, projects, skills, plugins. Private.

links.name: harnesses/omp
links.description: OMP root: agent databases, sessions, skills, browser profiles. Private.

links.name: harnesses/codex
links.description: Codex root: contains auth.json, sqlite databases, sessions. Private.

links.name: harnesses/pi
links.description: Pi root: agent settings, auth.json, prompts, sessions. Private.

links.name: harnesses/agents
links.description: Shared agents root: skills, agent definitions, tasks. Private.

links.name: harnesses/grok
links.description: Grok root: sessions, hooks, skills. Private.

links.name: harnesses/gemini
links.description: Gemini root: settings, accounts, history. Private.

links.name: harnesses/cursor
links.description: Cursor root: hooks, skills, projects. Private.

links.name: sessions/omp-history
links.description: OMP prompt history (SQLite). The -wal and -shm companion files stay next to the real file at the source; this is a symlink to the main file only, never a hardlink or copy.

links.name: skills/shared
links.description: Shared skills directory; ~/.gemini/skills is a symlink to this same directory.

links.name: hooks/workspace
links.description: Hook scripts in the Claude workspace (~/claude/hooks).
